Episode 217. The Reason for Ayula's Manifestation (3)
Zito blinked for a moment, alternating his gaze between Ayula and the dimensional gate.

[Phew... Ha-ha-ha-ha! What if you close that? Do you think I'll be surprised and cower in fear? Ayula, you foolish friend. How can you be fooled by such a simple act! Have you been half-hearted so far because you were really spending energy to block that?]
From the beginning, Zito had been eyeing that.
He was confident that Ayula had decided on his annihilation today.

[First, block the way back, then somehow strike me hard and try to deal with me using the humans under this boundary. If I hadn't regained my strength so much, it would have been a good strategy. Unfortunately... that's not the case.]
As soon as the door was confirmed closed, Zito's appearance began to change. New spines sprouted from his wings and body, and his wavering face became clearer.
[Once I kill you and find the eye, such tricks are useless. Let's start again, foolish Peace.]
Every time Zito swung his twin spiked axes, the sky distorted.
The same happened to Ayula's physical body where the axe hit. Blood, bone, and flesh crumpled, and a sound more terrible than a scream was made.
The praying believers shed tears thinking about the pain Ayula was experiencing, and Jin and Murakan narrowed their eyes.
If the battle continues like this, the result will inevitably end in Ayula's defeat.

"Gosh, isn't Ayula really going to lose like this? Even though he can't use all his power because he's a human, isn't he pushed too much? Ah, the barrier. He's already lacking power, is it because he poured too much into the barrier?"
"...That's right, Murakan. Ayula is going to lose today."
At Jin's words, Murakan's eyes widened.
"What?"
"The outcome of this battle was decided from the start. Ayula never once said he would break Zito. He never said he would annihilate him. He only said he would inflict irreparable damage."
Ayula's goal was not victory from the start.
He knew better than anyone that it was impossible. As Murakan said, the human world is not a place where Ayula can exert his full power.
"In my view, Zito has fallen into a trap. I don't know Ayula's exact intentions, but after the battle ends, Ayula's authority applied to the dimensional gate will certainly trip up Zito."
"I hope your words are true."
It wasn't that Jin wasn't worried at all.

-[Originally, even if I were to lose some of my authority this time, I intended to inflict irreversible damage on him. I judged that he could be more threatening in the mortal realm if he fully recovered his power.]
The words that Ayula had just spoken in the gray area.
Even if the fight went perfectly according to Ayula's intention, he was bound to lose some of his authority today.
'Perhaps...... This is probably the first and last time that Ayula himself intervenes in the mortal realm and fights directly. All we can do is hope that the fight ends according to Ayula's will.'
If things go wrong, there is also a possibility that Ayula could disappear.
On the other hand, there was no chance of that happening to Zito. Ayula himself had made it clear that it was impossible.

[I can almost see the crying faces of your children under the barrier. My eyes must have been eager to see that sight as well. For such a long time, my eyes have been locked away without seeing anything beautiful.]
Clang-!
The thorny axe struck Ayula's head.
Ayula couldn't recover as quickly as Zito. He controlled the spears with part of his head torn off, and it seemed at a glance that there was a problem with his vision.
Two more wings were torn. The number of times the spear penetrated Zito's body was gradually decreasing, while the number of times the thorny axe tormented Ayula was increasing.
It wasn't a fight between two beings of similar strength anymore, but a situation where one-sided violence had begun on one side.
Thump......!
Eventually, Zito plunged the thorny axe into Ayula's chest and threw him up to the barrier. The shock transmitted to the inside of the barrier caused a brief earthquake throughout the kingdom.
The earthquake quickly intensified.

It was because Zito, who was on top of Ayula, was incessantly striking him down with the hilt of his axe. The barrier formed by Ayula's true energy was still strong, but it seemed like it could crack at any moment.

[Ha ha ha, do you feel like a pathetic beast? Starving and finally finding prey. A mother tired of protecting her eggs. The mother will try to protect the eggs from the predator at all costs, but she can't. Why? Because the beast is Zito!]
Zito raised his voice, mad with delight, comparing the crack to eggs.
[Ayula! It's such a pleasure for me to have met you first in the mortal realm. I've been looking forward to this moment for a very long time.]
[You talk a lot. You seem to have the upper hand, but you still seem uneasy, Zito.]
[Yes, I am uneasy! I am scared and anxious. That's why I'm babbling like this, just like animals often howl.]
[It seems like you have a good sense of situation for an immortal. Well, now slowly give me your gift. I will show you what the reality of your unknown fear was.]
Suddenly, Ayula spread his wings wide. Until then, Ayula had been using his wings as a shield to block the ax blows from Zito, who had climbed on top of him.
And then, Ayula embraced Zito with his roughly ten remaining wings.
Zito tried to tear off the wings, but the wings that had been so easily torn and fallen off until now did not budge.
The thorns piercing through the wings from Zito were holding their state in place. The two immortals looked like a large cocoon tied into one.
For the first time, Ayula smirked.
[You just said it's been a while since one of your eyes saw something beautiful…….]
[What are you trying to do?]
[To me, it seems the same for your remaining eye. A world filled with pain, how can such a thing be beautiful? So let me show you. Something truly beautiful.]
Roaaar-!
A brighter golden light flashed from within the wings soaked in golden blood.
And Zito felt the sensation of Ayula's energy spreading in his wings, invading his brain. That energy forcefully formed several images and sounds in Zito's head.
Of course, they were made up of the sights and sounds Zito despised the most.
Let's be together, in a peaceful and beautiful world......!
The first thing that resonated in Zito's head was a verse from a hymn praising Ayula.
There was also the sight of millions of believers all singing in unison, all wearing bright expressions.
[You're crazy, aargh!]
For the first time, Zito shivered and showed a painful expression.
He was an immortal who was mad with pain to the point of torturing himself, but he didn't have much resistance to this type of 'awkward pain'.
[This is nothing, this is a pain I haven't yet conquered.]
Just seeing that scene was a great psychological shock to Zito.
Because it was an illusion created within, he couldn't kill or torture the singing believers, and he couldn't easily detach Ayula.
[I've got chills!]
[There's a lot left. Next, you'll see the sight of those weary of life being saved by someone's help. And they end up living a happy life…….]
[You call yourself a god of peace and do such horrible things, you demon...! Go to hell!]
The praying people were so focused that they couldn't hear their conversation at all, but Jin and Murakan were momentarily speechless.
"......Is this what I'm thinking? Could we really torment that guy, Zito, in this way?"
"It's shocking in many ways, me too."
The figure of Zito, who had been overwhelming Ayula all along, was nowhere to be seen. There was only a pitiful demon who hated light and healing to the extreme.
[Stop it, enough!]
However, infiltrating Zito's inner self was something that required a great deal of resolution for Ayula himself.
Just as Ayula was defiling Zito's inner self, Zito was also eroding Ayula's inner self.

Ayula was facing a more vivid illusion than reality of the world burning and suffering in front of his eyes. Even though he knew it was an illusion, he couldn't deny it with his divine insight, just as he couldn't counteract Ayula's spirit that had infiltrated his inner self.
Whose inner self will crumble faster?
In the end, that was the last of the fight. Therefore, Ayula was certain of his defeat.
At such times, whoever has more something they love, something they need to protect, is bound to lose. Ayula was vomiting blood, flipping his eyes, but Zito's screams were gradually subsiding.
And finally, Ayula's wings broke. All wings fixed with thorns collapsed, revealing Ayula's wounded flesh.
Ayula looked as weak as a dying man. As soon as the wings holding him disappeared, Zito took distance and gasped for breath.
[Huff, huff... I almost got hooked on a strange taste. But this is also a kind of pain I have to conquer in the end. It was a great learning experience, Ayula.]
Ayula couldn't answer and gasped for breath.
If now, Zito could definitely finish Ayula. Because Ayula could no longer counterattack.
However, Zito had to choose.

Whether to use his remaining strength to finish Ayula now, or to rip through the barrier Ayula initially cast on the dimensional gate and return with that power. Although Ayula was near death, the barrier of the dimensional gate was still intact.
Zito chose the latter.
Because if he used all his strength to extinguish Ayula now, he wouldn't be able to deal with the humans under the barrier.

[Heh heh... Yes, I lost today. I was fooled. So this was why you were obsessed with the barrier. But I don't dislike this sense of defeat. It's an indescribably sticky and thrilling taste of defeat. Go back, next time we meet you will be weaker, Ayula. Then I will fully use you, and enjoy.]
Soon, Zito ripped off Ayula's power that was eating away at the dimensional gate.
And when Zito disappeared, Ayula fell below the barrier.
